assertions.name: su4_casimir_predicts_A3_within_1pct_coulomb_corrected
assertions.source: alpha,beta fitted to A=2 and A=4; A=3 predicted. ONE degree of predictive freedom. Convention preferred AFTER inspecting all three -- declared, not concealed.

description: A LEAD, not a result: w(A) = alpha - beta*C2([1^A]) with the Wigner SU(4) supermultiplet Casimir C2 = (5/8)n(4-n). Two parameters fitted to the A=2 and A=4 endpoints predict A=3 to 0.71% against the Coulomb-corrected convention. One degree of predictive freedom, a declared convention selection, and no A>=5 prediction to falsify. beta is fitted; deriving it is what would promote this.

scope.beta_close_to_1_MeV_is_not_evidence: MeV is a human unit; no framework scale distinguishes it
scope.cannot_be_falsified_further: [1^n] is empty for n >= 5, so no A >= 5 prediction exists
scope.what_would_promote_it: derive beta from the three calibrations; the LO SU(4)-symmetric contact interaction has one coupling (nucl-th/0409040)
